body:
The unchanged installed official Biopython pipeline completed unattended through billing, both anonymous HF readbacks, original owned cleanup and byte-inert completed replay. **Zero exports / zero PR validation attempts / zero independent exported-task controls**: #5382 had no test patch; #5372 added regression assertions inside an existing method and was filtered as `no_new_test_funcs`. [Final evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/a3e17aed/experiments/57-fresh-biopython/final-summary.json). Subissue of #33.

**Cost:** 10 original bootstrap calls / **$0.377562**; primary plus cleanup **0.484837222 allocated CPUh**. Bootstrap saved 3379 collected tests with nine missing-dependency collection errors; smoke/fresh-image flags are false. Those warnings are separate from the structural skips; no PR pre/post suite or exported-task control ran.

All owned containers/controllers/images/volumes are verified empty, the shared public base is preserved, and original jobs/controller are terminal. Both append-only HF snapshots have verified anonymous readback; exact manifests/receipts and replay proof are linked in comments. Duplicate early inspection copy removed after canonical/HF verification; source/runtime evidence retained under HOME, no owned `/tmp` evidence.

[#58](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/issues/58) / [#59](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/issues/59) investigate separately declared generic filter/targeting behavior. This original baseline remains unchanged: no retry, test/import/install/parser/grading/timeout repair, added LLM stage, source-provenance plugin or APT policy. Keep issue/epic/PRs open for review; no accepted fresh task, automatic merge or dataset release.
